title: OpenAI Proposes Giving U.S. Government a 5% Equity Stake in All Leading AI Labs — Bloomberg/CNBC
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has proposed giving the U.S. government a 5% equity stake (~$42.6B at OpenAI's $852B valuation) as a model for all leading U.S. AI developers, framed as an Alaska-style public AI wealth fund. The proposal could extend to Alphabet and Meta if adopted broadly. Talks are early-stage and may require an act of Congress; OpenAI declined to comment.
why: 若正式推进，可能倒逼Alphabet/Google、Meta等上市AI公司参与类似安排，影响股权结构与监管成本；对谷歌(GOOGL)期权隐含波动率有潜在扰动；整体利好AI监管确定性，长期偏中性。

title: Tesla Officially Launches Unsupervised Robotaxi Service in Miami (July 3) — First Market Beyond Texas and California
summary: Tesla launched its fully unsupervised Robotaxi service in Miami, FL on July 3, 2026 — the first market outside Texas (Austin/Dallas/Houston/San Antonio) and the Bay Area. Model Y vehicles operate in a ~10-14 sq mile geofence around Miami International Airport. The purpose-built Cybercab (no steering wheel/pedals) is expected to join the fleet when volume production scales in late 2026.
why: Robotaxi商业化地理扩张加速TSLA从汽车厂商向自动驾驶软件平台的估值重构；7月22日Q2财报前情绪催化剂显著，sell put持有人需评估行权价对TSLA可能继续上涨的保护。
source: TeslaNorth / Not A Tesla App / Electrek

title: Global stocks rally July 3 as U.S. markets close for Independence Day: Korea KOSPI +5.8%, SK Hynix +10.9%, HSI +1.3%, Nikkei +1.5%
summary: With U.S. markets closed Friday July 3 (Independence Day observed; July 4 falls on Saturday), global equities rallied sharply. Korea's KOSPI surged 5.8% to 8,088, recovering most of the prior session's ~8% drop — SK Hynix soared 10.9%, Samsung +8.2%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng added 1.3% to 23,350. Japan's Nikkei gained 1.5% to 69,744. The Dow had set a fresh record in Wednesday's final session before the holiday. U.S. markets reopen Monday July 6; near-term catalysts include SpaceX Nasdaq-100 inclusion (July 7) and SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR listing (~July 10).
why: 港股恒指收23,350（+1.3%）；韩国AI内存链强力反弹（SK海力士+10.9%）预示7月6日美股开盘时半导体板块情绪修复；美股重开后关注芯片股能否延续此轮反弹，对sell put策略而言波动率环境相对友好。注：今日（7月4日独立日）为美国公共假期，市场重大头条偏少，此为本轮主要宏观头条。

title: Micron (MU) quarterly dividend $0.15/share, ex-date Monday July 6 — first trading day after U.S. holiday
summary: Micron Technology (MU) has a quarterly cash dividend of $0.15/share with ex-dividend date July 6, 2026 (Monday, first U.S. trading day after the Independence Day holiday), payable July 21. This follows Micron's record Q3 FY2026 results (revenue $41.46B, +346% YoY, EPS $25.11). HBM supply remains fully committed through 2026.
why: 除权日7月6日为美股重开首日，持有MU covered call或short put期权策略者需注意：股价理论上将除息调整$0.15（约0.03%），影响极小；但结合Q3超预期业绩与HBM供不应求，July期权到期前（7月18日）可能存在额外催化剂。
